name: Null-safe filter excludes negative/null qty from positive aggregation
expected: Mixed quote (one line Qty=+5, one Qty=-1, plus a null-qty leg) repriced under V21: the negative/null-qty lines are EXCLUDED from the positive null-safe aggregate (header positive aggregate = +5 line only = 5x2800 = 14000, NOT the naive 11200 that would include the -1 line), and NO NPE / engine error is thrown.
actual: Fresh mixed quote 0Q0WC000003FbDd0AK on Fortra Price Book USD, both lines NSS-SNMP Trap Receiver (PBE 01uWC000005wo41YAA, list 2800): posLine 0QLWC000003kke14AA Qty=+5, negLine 0QLWC000003kke24AA Qty=-1. PRE-reprice naive header (engine NotStarted) = Subtotal/TotalPrice/GrandTotal 11200 (= 5x2800 + (-1x2800), negative INCLUDED). V21 Force-reprice REST isSuccess=true, errorResponse=[], NO NPE; quote CalculationStatus NotStarted->CompletedWithPricing. POST-reprice: header Subtotal=14000, ALE__c=14000 (= ONLY the +5 line, negative EXCLUDED - NOT 11200). Line level: posLine TotalLineAmount=14000/Subtotal=14000; negLine TotalLineAmount=0/Subtotal=0 (negative zeroed, never subtracted). Positive-only CONTROL quote 0Q0WC000003FbIT0A0 (+5 line, no negative) repriced to the IDENTICAL Subtotal=14000/ALE__c=14000, proving the negative line contributed exactly 0 to the positive aggregate. NULL leg: a QLI with null Quantity is rejected by the platform at DML (FIELD_INTEGRITY_EXCEPTION 'Quantity must be a whole number.', SaveResult success=false id=null) so a literal null-qty line cannot be saved; the engine's LineItemQuantity>=0 filter additionally excludes any transient null. (NetUnitPrice/TotalPrice/GrandTotal=0 on the perpetual lines is the documented headless perpetual-net-seeding quirk SC-3345/SC-3347 - present IDENTICALLY in the +5-only control, so not a K-10 effect; the K-10 assertion is on the LIST-based aggregate Subtotal/ALE__c.)
